subject: Offer: work-permit support & relocation subsidy for Ricardo Alvarez
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New grad offer — work-permit & relocation support request for Ricardo Alvarez

Hi team,

We're ready to move forward with Ricardo Alvarez (accepted verbally) for the Senior ML Engineer role. He is currently in Mexico and will need a US work-permit application supported by Redwood, plus relocation assistance. I pulled estimates from GlobalMove and our immigration counsel; attaching the stubs.

High-level numbers (estimates):
- Immigration counsel (work-permit + employer paperwork): $6,500
- Government and filing fees (premium processing option selected): $2,000
- Relocation subsidy (lump-sum to candidate for household move + initial housing support): $12,000
- One-time arrival allowance (temporary housing / travel): $1,500
- Total estimated one-time cost: $22,000

Requested approvals:
1) Approve a relocation package up to $12k (plus $1.5k arrival allowance).
2) Approve immigration/legal spend up to $8.5k (covers counsel + filing/premium).
3) Allow HR to engage GlobalMove to produce final SOW and schedule pickup.

Notes: candidate is targeting a start date of 2026-08-10. We have a signed offer PDF (attached) pending final approval on relocation/immigration spend.

Can we get a quick approval from Finance (Rishi) and a headcount confirmation from Laura? If we should trim numbers, Monica can propose options (lower lump-sum + move stipend).

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New grad offer — work-permit & relocation support request for Ricardo Alvarez

Thanks Monica — quick answers:
- Headcount is approved for the role (FY26 hiring plan, slot 3 in ML eng). No further headcount block.
- Compensation band fits the approved range; compensation team already signed off on base/bonus.

On the package numbers: Laura here (hiring manager) — I'm comfortable with the $12k relocation + $1.5k arrival allowance. We should prioritize getting Ricardo on site quickly; premium processing for the permit makes sense.

If Finance pushes back, we can split the relocation into a $7k lump sum + $5k reimbursable receipts model. Please proceed with the vendor SOW and let me know if you need a manager-level exception.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, ML Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: New grad offer — work-permit & relocation support request for Ricardo Alvarez

Monica / Laura,

Thanks for the breakdown. Quick finance view: we can approve up to $15k in total one-time hiring-related spend from the central hiring budget for this candidate. That would require us to cap relocation + arrival allowance to $9k (example: $7k lump + $2k arrival) and move immigration/legal costs under the recruiting reimbursement pool (up to $6k) — otherwise we will need to run this as a manager exception out of Laura's headcount budget.

Because the role is mission-critical, I'm OK signing off on the manager exception if Laura confirms she can cover the delta (~$7k) from her hiring budget. If not, propose the hybrid model and HR will finalize the offer language.

Can HR also provide a quote from GlobalMove with itemized services and a payment schedule (vendor PO preferred).

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Finance Business Partner | Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New grad offer — work-permit & relocation support request for Ricardo Alvarez

Thanks all — consolidating next steps and approvals so I can close the offer in Workday. Summary and actions: 

1) Headcount: confirmed (Laura) — proceed.
2) Finance: central approval for up to $15k total hiring spend; manager to cover delta. Laura to confirm whether to sign manager exception (approx $7k) or proceed with the hybrid cap.
3) HR (Monica) to request final itemized SOW from GlobalMove and a separate line from immigration counsel that separates counsel fees vs filing fees. Attachments requested: final SOW PDF, itemized invoice for counsel, and the signed offer PDF (already attached).
4) Offer language: Monica to include a clause that relocation beyond the lump-sum will be reimbursable with receipts for 90 days post-start; immigration expenses paid directly to counsel/vendor.

Monica: if Laura confirms manager exception, I will mark Workday as "Offer Approved — Manager Exception" and route funds. If not, please prepare the hybrid package and send the amended offer to Ricardo for signature (DocuSign link preferred).

Ricardo — cc'd on the offer thread in case you want to confirm timing — we will aim to finalize financials by end of week to keep the 8/10 start viable.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
People Operations | Redwood Inference
